<b>Covetous Pilgrims</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are strong pilgrims holding an abudance of strung up [[Rosary|Rosaries]] that they use as a whip.<ref>Covetous Pilgrim [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Strong bug replete with rosaries. If angered they will whip their strings in a ceaseless onslaught."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Covetous Pilgrims do not naturally wander, and start out crouched and muttering to themselves. Once they notice Hornet, they yell and will now attack her when she is within range.<br>
Covetous Pilgrims walk towards Hornet in between attacks, and have 4 moves:

* <b>Charge:</b> The Covetous Pilgrim charges towards Hornet, stopping once she is behind it or it hits a wall.
* <b>Leaping Lash:</b> Jumps towards Hornet, then lashes with its Rosary string in an overhead swing in front of itself as it lands, covering a large area. A Rosary may fly off the Covetous Pilgrim during the lash of this attack.
* <b>String Flail:</b> It spins its Rosary strings before whipping them ahead of and behind itself 3 times. Rosaries may fly off the Covetous Pilgrim during this attack.
* <b>Retreat:</b> Slides backwards a set distance, often used after missing an attack and when Hornet is close to it.

All the Covetous Pilgrim's attacks, including contact damage, deal {{Damage|2}}.

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* Holy, holy, gather it up!
* All is mine... for me, for me!
* A little more... ‘tis all I need...
* To ascend... triumphantly...
}}

== Location ==
A total of three Covetous Pilgrims can be found throughout [[Pharloom]] but only two can exist at a time. One can be found in [[Shellwood]]'s grave west of the area. Another can be found at [[Shakra]]'s former camp in [[Bilewater]] once [[Groal the Great]] has been defeated. The last only appears in [[Act 3]] at [[Bonegrave]] in [[Bone Bottom]].

== Trivia ==
*The 1.0.27535 and 1.0.27776 versions of <i>Silksong</i> playable on PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch respectively, which are older than the PC launch version (1.0.28324), have different journal notes from Hornet:<ref>[https://docs.google.com/document/d/1GaNLkTTszFKFv55DZj3Iw1hTUi6gbstSR56WXizrMAI Silksong Switch full text] on Google Docs</ref>
:"<i>Is their wealth a sign of purity or greed? Surely most would see it as sin to horde so much?</i>"
* Covetous Pilgrims are unable to become [[Black-Threaded]] during Act 3.
* Covetous Pilgrims are one of the few enemies that never respawns.
* Rosaries dropped by Covetous Pilgrims always drop in single Rosaries instead of Shell or Pearl Rosaries.
